integrity: The chain-ring annihilator classes and adjacency are derived directly from valuations. The zero-forcing and Fibonacci enumeration follow from a simultaneous induction on the standard antiregular recurrence, with a separate ready-set state. Real maximum nullity then follows from the published threshold-graph equality M=Z.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite commutative chain rings.
The compressed graph forgets residue-field size and chain-ring isomorphism type.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
The complete zero forcing polynomial is not determined.
The equality M=Z for threshold graphs is prior structural coverage; the new work is the chain-ring identification, exact Z, and Fibonacci minimum-set count.
title: Fibonacci minimum zero forcing sets in compressed zero-divisor graphs of finite chain rings
